evidence: New clients in VLAN 60 receive no IP address.
Topology shows clients connect through SW11 to R16 DHCP service.
show ip dhcp pool on R16 shows a pool named STAFF for network 192.168.60.0/24 but indicates no pool exists for VLAN 60 network 192.168.160.0/24.
show ip interface brief on R16 shows Gi0/1.60 with IP 192.168.160.1 in an up/up state.
root_cause: The DHCP service on R16 lacks a DHCP pool for the VLAN 60 network 192.168.160.0/24.
verification: Run show ip dhcp pool on R16 and confirm the pool for network 192.168.160.0/24 is present.
Confirm that a new client in VLAN 60 successfully obtains an IP address.
fix_steps: Verify the missing DHCP pool for network 192.168.160.0/24 using show ip dhcp pool.
Configure a DHCP pool on R16 corresponding to the VLAN 60 network 192.168.160.0/24 with appropriate network, default-router, and other required parameters.
Verify the new DHCP pool configuration using show ip dhcp pool and show running-config.
Test that clients in VLAN 60 successfully receive an IP address.

rule_checker_findings.evidence: show ip dhcp pool indicates required VLAN network pool is missing.
rule_checker_findings.recommended_action: Configure DHCP pool and subinterface for required VLAN network.
